dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Three prominent O-shaped structures exhibit high-contrast white perimeters against a dark dorsal-lateral substrate. The largest central structure has a jagged, irregular boundary with a sharp gradient into a medium-grey core. A dorsal-mid structure is horizontally elongated and elliptical with a smoother perimeter line. A posterior-lateral structure presents as a C-shape with a distinct break in the high-intensity border on its ventral side.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of solid, high-intensity white punctate clusters lacking internal gradients. These are primarily distributed in the lower-posterior quadrant of the visible flank, with approximately 10-12 discrete blobs appearing as localized pixel concentrations.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three primary macro-annuli (central jagged, dorsal elliptical, and posterior C-shape) form an obtuse scalene triangle. A sub-constellation consisting of a near-linear chain of four high-intensity blobs is positioned ventral to the central jagged annulus.
